body:
Welcomes the candidates and explains the five-day structure of the Fog Courts trials.

Recorded role and choices

On 31 August 2024, Vinerba welcomes the selected apprentices, explains the four days of ability trials and the fifth-day combat examination, and introduces Professor Elverus Crepe as their curriculum guide. Her ceremonial speech establishes this welcome and introduction, without establishing that she heads the institution.
